latest_cos_commentary.headline: Agilysys is a 45-year hospitality software vendor (POS, PMS, inventory, payments) posting record FY2026 revenue of $319.3M with 30%+ subscription growth, led by CEO Ramesh Srinivasan.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Directly competes on pos and payments, particularly in hotel/resort food-and-beverage outlets and multi-amenity properties where InfoGenesis POS is embedded alongside property management.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Subscription revenue growth (30.2% YoY) and record FY2026 results suggest continued cloud-migration momentum industry-wide.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a prospect already runs Agilysys PMS for lodging/gaming, expect InfoGenesis POS to be the incumbent for attached F&B outlets — competitive displacement there is a PMS-plus-POS bundle decision, not POS alone.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Named wins found here are hospitality/resort accounts, not standalone quick-service or full-service restaurant chains — do not over-generalize restaurant-market share from these examples.
